chapter.title: Subscriptions
chapter.para: A client may create up to eight event subscriptions per device.

chapter.title: Delivery
chapter.para: The device shall deliver events using HTTPS.
Each notification shall contain a timestamp, an event identifier, and a sequence number.
Notifications shall be delivered in sequence-number order.
A client shall acknowledge each notification within 2 seconds.
The device shall retry an unacknowledged notification up to 10 times.

chapter.title: Reconnection
chapter.para: A client may resume delivery by providing the last acknowledged sequence number.
The device shall retain notification history for 30 minutes.
